schema = "codex-loop-model-profiles/v1"
active_profile = "sonnet46-all"

# Profiles control both the ordinary execution family and the explicit review
# family.  Sol remains the root and is never used as an implicit child.
[profiles.v4f]
label = "DeepSeek V4 Flash"
execution_model = "weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash"
execution_reasoning = "ultra"
review_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
review_reasoning = "max"

[profiles.glm]
label = "GLM 5.2"
execution_model = "alibaba-token-plan/glm-5.2"
execution_reasoning = "ultra"
review_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
review_reasoning = "max"

[profiles.k3-only]
label = "K3 temporary fallback"
execution_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
execution_reasoning = "max"
review_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
review_reasoning = "max"

[profiles.sonnet46-dual]
label = "Claude Sonnet 4.6 Execution + K3 Review"
execution_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
execution_reasoning = "ultra"
review_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
review_reasoning = "max"

[profiles.sonnet46-all]
label = "Claude Sonnet 4.6 Execution + Review"
execution_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
execution_reasoning = "ultra"
review_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
review_reasoning = "ultra"

[profiles.v4f-sonnet-review]
label = "DeepSeek V4 Flash Execution + Claude Sonnet 4.6 Review"
execution_model = "weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash"
execution_reasoning = "ultra"
review_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
review_reasoning = "ultra"

# ============================================================================
# orchestration_policy.toml тА?declaration face = enforcement face (invariant 2)
# Every key below is read by exactly one enforcing component under
# impl/harness/.  Concurrency numbers do NOT live here (single source of
# truth: config/refill_policy.toml тА?see [concurrency_ref]).
# ============================================================================
schema = "codex-loop-orchestration-policy/v2"
status = "phase2-implementation"

[routing]
# cold_start | shadow | layered.  Defaults to cold_start (byte-identical to
# legacy behavior).  agent_router.py refuses "layered" unless ALL six
# mechanical gate guards pass (consumer heartbeat, exactly-once canary,
# verifier pin, short-result validator, statemachine schema, rollback key).
mode = "cold_start"
trivial_packet_direct_to_v4 = true
plan_expansion_min_packets = 3
plan_expansion_on_cross_platform = true
plan_expansion_on_release_or_audit = true
plan_expansion_when_sol_5h_above = 0.25
send_l2_consumer = "k3_verifier_headless"
explicit_high_risk_route = "direct_l3"
verify_sample_rate = 0.10
l2_max_age_s = 900
l2_heartbeat_max_age_s = 300
statemachine_schema_required = "codex-loop-statemachine/v2"
rollback_key = "routing.mode=cold_start"

[models]
# The ONLY place model ids are written.  Code reads these pins; nothing under
# impl/harness/ contains a model string (fixes the hardcoded-model defect
# class; current deployment values below).
sol = "alibaba-token-plan/glm-5.2"
k3 = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"
v4 = "weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash"

[model_context]
# effective ~940.5k for sol (990k window), compaction 800k; k3 1M/800k.
sol = { context_window = 990000, compaction = 800000, reasoning = "ultra" }
k3 = { context_window = 1000000, compaction = 800000, reasoning = "max" }
v4 = { context_window = 1000000, compaction = 800000, reasoning = "ultra" }

[ipybox]
# Task constraint: Desktop-native ipybox stays DISABLED; WSL/headless exec
# workers get explicit ipybox; K3 planning/verifying roles run without ipybox
# unless the packet declares needs_code_execution=true.
desktop_native_enabled = false
wsl_headless_enabled = true
k3_roles_enabled = false
k3_enable_on_needs_code_execution = true

[context]
inherit_root_transcript = false
control_packet_compiler = "deterministic"
decision_skeleton_max_new_tokens = 1200
root_control_max_new_tokens_per_wave = 2000
ordinary_revision_max_new_tokens = 500
adjudication_packet_max_new_tokens = 2000
child_short_result_max_tokens = 500
child_short_result_max_findings = 8

[tokens]
metric = "production_effective_tokens"
primary_window_seconds = 18000
minimum_denominator = 2000000
sol_target_low = 0.20
sol_target_high = 0.25
sol_hard_cap = 0.15
k3_floor = 0.20
k3_total_observation_low = 0.10
k3_total_observation_high = 0.25
k3_verify_observation_low = 0.02
k3_verify_observation_high = 0.08
v4_observation_low = 0.50
v4_observation_high = 0.75
structural_alert_sol_above = 0.25
structural_alert_k3_below = 0.05

[hysteresis]
enter_high_sol_share = 0.25
enter_samples = 2
leave_high_sol_share = 0.22
leave_samples = 2
critical_1h_share = 0.35
critical_5h_share = 0.35

[budget]
# Three-tier ladder thresholds (budget_controller.py).
throttle_at = 0.60
degrade_at = 0.85
break_at = 1.00
state_cooldown_s = 60
reclaim_on_completion = true
allocation_headroom = 0.30

[governor]
planning_max_turns = 6
planning_max_new_tokens = 30000
meter_stale_after_s = 7200
lease_renew_on_packet_creation = true

[concurrency_ref]
# Single source of truth for all concurrency numbers (invariant 3).
# NOTE: no numbers here on purpose тА?refill_policy.toml is authoritative.
refill_policy_ref = "config/refill_policy.toml"

# Codex LOOP execution-plane safety policy тА?THE ONLY concurrency authority.
# (P0-8.3 single-source-of-truth fix: VERSIONS.lock and config.toml.example
# reference this file instead of copying its numbers; refill_state.json
# records policy_version+mtime and recomputes on mismatch.)

[meta]
policy_version = "2026-08-13.dialogue-20-global-80"

[concurrency]
# One parent/dialogue normally sustains 20 agents. LOOP's cross-dialogue,
# cross-plane total target is 80; semantic role reservations remain distinct.
# distinct. model_profile.py changes models, never these concurrency values.
dialogue_target = 20
target_total = 80
v4_target = 60
k3_target = 20
v4_low_water = 45
k3_low_water = 15
# Reservations are borrowable: an empty K3 queue leaves K3 slots available
# to V4; demand-backed K3 work reclaims them via the watermark logic.
reservations_borrowable = true

[spawn_throttle]
spawn_interval_ms = 1000
max_initializing = 8
health_gate_every = 8
failure_backoff_seconds = 30
health_timeout_ms = 2000
